Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for renting the Sigma 18-35 from us, and for returning it so promptly. I want to explain why part of your $600 deposit was kept, and I'm sorry this isn't the news you were hoping for.

When we inspected the lens on return, we found a scratch on the front element. We deducted $160 from your deposit to cover it, because we consider this damage beyond normal wear and tear. I know an unexpected deduction is frustrating, and I'd like you to see exactly what we saw. I'm happy to send photos of the scratch if you'd like to look at them.

We also want to be fair to you. As a goodwill gesture, we can lower the deduction to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you.

How would you like to proceed? Just let me know if you'd like the photos, the reduced deduction with the $60 refund, or if you have any questions first.

Thank you for your understanding, Aoife.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
